# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for JsRuntimeHost
#
# These suppress data races internal to third-party libraries that we cannot fix.
# TSan on macOS (JavaScriptCore via Xcode) passes clean — these suppressions are
# only needed for the Ubuntu Bun JSC build.

# Bun's Linux JavaScriptCore is statically linked into the final executable, so
# a called_from_lib suppression cannot identify it. Match the interceptor frames
# previously observed on JSC's JIT worker threads instead.
# Races manifest in TSan interceptors (free/memcpy/close) called from
# JSC's JIT worker threads.
race:free
race:close
race:memcpy

# JSC signal handler that doesn't save/restore errno
signal:WTF::jscSignalHandler

# Bun's WTF (statically linked): the thread suspend/resume handler used by the conservative
# stack scan does not preserve errno (TSan's "signal handler spoils errno"), and the
# ref-counted thread bootstrap/parking structures destroy their mutex or condition variable
# right after the other side's final use, which TSan reports as a race on
# pthread_mutex_destroy / pthread_cond_destroy. Both show up once several runtimes (workers)
# start and stop in one process.
signal:WTF::Thread::signalHandlerSuspendResume
race:WTF::Thread::NewThreadContext::~NewThreadContext
race:ThreadData::~ThreadData
